facts.text: Founded in 1884 as the first public college for women in the United States, The W has been home to noted personalities including Pulitzer Prize-winning author Eudora Welty.

sources.title: About The W - Mississippi University for Women
sources.quote: Founded in 1884 as the first public college for women in the United States, The W is a tradition-rich university that has been home to such noted personalities as Pulitzer Prize-winning author Eudora Welty, among others.
